steps: one Sonnet minion builds ext/Chat/Drill.js + the Open action + hash route

decision.what: The drill shell lives in ext/Chat (a ChatDrill view opened from ChatPanel), mounted on document.body (phone: fixed full screen over the sheet) or over the .drawer (desktop: full drawer height), so rail.js is never touched.
decision.alternative: desktop shell in the page main area: rejected, the chat you drilled from would vanish from beside the page
decision.why: rail.js is fenced (voice-sessions-2, audio-consolidate); minion-sheet-as-page is routing the sheet itself with ?sheet=, so the drill uses the hash #chat=... and the two compose

log.msg: minion-drill-build queued 5+ min at the memory gate (1.2 GB free); dequeued it and built the piece myself, per the sub-mastermind rule

experiment.result: before: level 1 (opened before the refined line arrived); after waiting for the whole path: level 2

findings.text: All four asks are met. A selected card with contents grows "Open ⤢" (ext/Chat/Chat.js:147). It opens a full-screen shell with Back and paging one level deeper (ext/Chat/Drill.js). Each level is routed by the hash `#chat=<session>~<at>/…` (Drill.js:260). The "tiny page, no directory" mapping and when a card graduates are in doc/drill.md "A card is a tiny page". The desktop choice (over the drawer, full height) names its alternative in doc/decisions.md and at Drill.js:344. v1 stays reachable with `drill: false`.

The review sheet (review/shots/…/sheet.png) only shows the top of /framework/ext/Chat/panel/. The Drill-in demo is far below the fold at 1280, 1920 and 3440, so a reader landing on the page can't see the new feature without scrolling a long way. The task's own shots/400-*.png and 1920-*.png do show it working. Consider putting the Drill-in demo near the top of the panel page, or giving it its own child page.

In shots/400-3-level2.png the parent crumb "A card is a tiny page… (+1 more)" is centred under "Chat ›" instead of sitting on the same line, because a `<button>` centres its text by default. It also repeats the title right below it. Adding `text-align: start` to `.chatbox-drill-crumb` (Chat.css:63) fixes the alignment; a shorter crumb (for example "Refined") would cut the repeat.

`encodeURIComponent` does not encode `~`, and parse_hash splits on the first `~` (Drill.js:261, :266). A session name or `watch` url that contains `~` would break the route. Splitting on the last `~`, or escaping `~` by hand, closes the gap.

A heading reply is now stored in the `bubbles` map (Chat.js:174) so that `card_of()` can open it. This means `refine()` (Chat.js:211) could, in principle, rewrite that bubble if a refined line's `of` named the reply's id. That is unlikely today, but worth one guard (skip entries that have `head`).
doc/files.jsonl also adds `floor.md`, which is not part of this task. The file exists, so nothing breaks; it is just out of scope for this diff.

answer.reply: fixed: the demo has its own page, /framework/ext/Chat/drill/, linked from Chat's children and from the panel page
fixed: .chatbox-drill-crumb text-align: start; the parent crumb now reads '(+1 more)', distinct from the level title
fixed: ~ escaped by hand as %7E in drill_hash()
fixed: refine() skips a bubble with head
fixed: files.jsonl changes dropped from the branch; the indexer writes them

log.msg: bands, drill shell: 400 header 90px (Back + crumb + title, title wraps to 2 lines, fine), cards full width 16px gutter; 1200/1920 header and cards share one centred 40em column, no stacked padding; 3440 same column, lots of empty below because a card holds 2-3 items (right for a card page); drawer 304px: Back + 2-line title, cards fill. Page /framework/ext/Chat/drill/: the demo's code block sits above the live panel (demo() default), frame capped at 100% at 400
